title: Anxiety
chief_complaint: Anxiety with palpitations, tremor, and sweating
hpi_narrative: {{patient_name}} is a young woman who presents with anxiety, palpitations, tremor, and sweating. She reports feeling nervous and on edge. Symptoms could be mistaken for a primary psychiatric disorder, but the presentation warrants evaluation for medical causes of anxiety — especially hyperthyroidism, substance use, arrhythmia, and withdrawal. She is of child-bearing age; pregnancy status affects choice of antithyroid therapy.
case_summary:
Differential: Anxiety, Atrial fibrillation, Early menopause, Mitral valve prolapse, Panic attack, Withdrawal syndrome, Stimulant intoxication.

The patient in this case has Graves' hyperthyroidism with a very clear history and classic physical exam findings (tremor, sweating, pretibial myxedema, exophthalmos). The best way to treat this patient is to start both symptomatic treatment with a beta-blocker (propranolol) and an antithyroid medication such as methimazole or PTU. Both are acceptable, but methimazole is almost always the first-line choice with the exception of the first trimester of pregnancy, during which PTU is preferred, due to methimazole's teratogenicity. This is why it's important to order a urine pregnancy test on this patient prior to treatment. Surgery and radioiodine ablation are alternative options to treat Graves' hyperthyroidism, but it's important to know that patients with significant symptoms of hyperthyroidism (such as this patient) need to be treated with antithyroid medications and achieve a euthyroid state before either of these other treatment options are pursued.

Anxiety — Internal Medicine
A young woman presents with anxiety, palpitations, tremor, and sweating.
physical_exam: Tachycardia; evaluate for arrhythmia contributing to palpitations.
Examine for pulmonary pathology that could contribute to anxiety symptoms.
Screen for abdominal pathology contributing to symptoms.
Tremor; psychiatric symptoms may reflect underlying hyperthyroidism.

patient_voice.chief_complaint: I can't stop feeling anxious and my heart races. My hands are shaking.
patient_voice.history: I've been nervous, sweaty, and shaky. I thought it was just stress but it's not getting better.
patient_voice.pain: My chest feels fluttery when my heart races.
